name: jsonl-explorer
description: JSONL Explorer - A client-side web app to explore multi-GB JSONL files

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/app/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/app/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter=@jsonl-explorer/shared test:unit && pnpm --filter=jsonl-explorer-app test:unit && pnpm --filter=jsonlex test:unit
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter=@jsonl-explorer/shared test:unit && pnpm --filter=jsonl-explorer-app test:unit && pnpm --filter=jsonlex test:unit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter=@jsonl-explorer/shared build && pnpm --filter=jsonl-explorer-app build && pnpm --filter=jsonlex build
scripts.gate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter jsonl-explorer-app check:docs && pnpm --filter jsonl-explorer-app check:credits && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm --filter jsonl-explorer-app check:production && pnpm test:e2e
